pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with irregular, sub-rounded vertices. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients with soft transitions between tan pigmentation and light background. Spatial density is high on the flank with medium-sized contiguous regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of wide light-pelage pathways. Topological junctions are primarily tri-radiate. Pixel thickness of corridors is relatively uniform across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck mane. Individual hair tufts create a fine-textured serrated edge against the dark background pixels.
